notes: Source was the InputPlumber-normalized Microsoft Xbox Series S|X Controller on /dev/input/event8.
Physical south/A input was remapped to synthetic KEY_A and BTN_EAST outputs.
The wrapped validation child ran as korri-remap-runner and received both keyboard and gamepad output.
Korri user readers received no events.
The wrapper's Sway isolation gate passed with no active synthetic devices.
Cleanup verified that synthetic devices disappeared after child exit.

Earlier failed attempts caught two product issues before this pass: event-only InputPlumber Xbox devices needed known-name gamepad classification, and Sway isolation should fail on active devices rather than on disabled/listed devices.
